description_en: Queries the information about the created fileset
kebab_example: aliyun nas get-fileset --file-system-id cpfs-099394bd928c0000 --fset-id fset-1902718ea0ae0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetFileset

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the file system.

The IDs of CPFS file systems must start with `cpfs-`. Example: cpfs-125487\\.
The IDs of CPFS for Lingjun file systems must start with `bmcpfs-`. Example: bmcpfs-0015\\
parameters.help_zh:
文件系统ID。

CPFS：必须以`cpfs-`开头，例如cpfs-125487\\。

CPFS智算版：必须以`bmcpfs-`开头，例如bmcpfs-0015\\
parameters.name: file_system_id

parameters.help_en:
The fileset ID.

This parameter is required for CPFS file systems
parameters.help_zh:
Fileset ID。
当文件系统类型为CPFS时，该参数必填
parameters.name: fset_id

CreateTime.description_en:
The time when the fileset was created.

Return format: `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`
CreateTime.description_zh:
Fileset的创建时间。

返回格式：`yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`

DeletionProtection.description_en:
Specifies whether the fileset is protected from being released through the console or the [DeleteFileset]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2402263.html） operation.

true: Enables release protection. The fileset cannot be released.
false (default): Disables release protection. The fileset can be released.

This parameter can protect filesets only against manual releases, but not against automatic releases
DeletionProtection.description_zh:
实例释放保护属性，指定是否支持通过控制台或API（[DeleteFileset]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2402263.html））释放实例。

true：开启实例释放保护。
false（默认）：关闭实例释放保护。

该属性只能限制手动释放操作，对系统释放操作不生效

FileCountUsage.description_en:
The usage of the file quantity.

Only CPFS for LINGJUN V2.7.0 and later support this parameter
FileCountUsage.description_zh:
文件数量使用量。
仅CPFS智算版2.7.0及以上版本支持此参数

FileSystemId.description_en:
The ID of the file system.

The IDs of CPFS file systems must start with `cpfs-`. Example: cpfs-125487\\.
The IDs of CPFS for Lingjun file systems must start with `bmcpfs-`. Example: bmcpfs-0015\\
FileSystemId.description_zh:
文件系统ID。

CPFS：必须以`cpfs-`开头，例如cpfs-125487\\。

CPFS智算版：必须以`bmcpfs-`开头，例如bmcpfs-0015\\

FileSystemPath.description_en: The directory of the fileset in the CPFS file system

FsetId.description_en:
The fileset ID.

This parameter is required for CPFS file systems
FsetId.description_zh:
Fileset ID。
当文件系统类型为CPFS时，该参数必填

Quota.description_en:
The quota information.

Only CPFS for Lingjun V2.7.0 and later support this parameter
Quota.description_zh:
配额信息。
仅CPFS智算版2.7.0及以上版本支持此参数

FileCountLimit.description_en:
The file quantity quota. Valid values:

Minimum value: 10,000.
Maximum value: 10,000,000,000
FileCountLimit.description_zh:
配额文件数量限制。取值范围：

最小值：10,000。

最大值：10,000,000,000

SizeLimit.description_en:
The total quota capacity limit. Unit: bytes.

Valid values:

Minimum value: 10,737,418,240 (10 GiB).
Step size: 1,073,741,824 (1 GiB)
SizeLimit.description_zh:
配额总容量限制。单位：Byte。

取值范围：

最小值：10,737,418,240（10 GiB）。

步长：1,073,741,824（1 GiB）

SpaceUsage.description_en:
The capacity usage. Unit: bytes.

Only CPFS for Lingjun V2.7.0 and later support this parameter
SpaceUsage.description_zh:
容量使用量。单位：Byte。
仅CPFS智算版2.7.0及以上版本支持此参数

Status.description_en:
The fileset status. Valid values:

CREATING: The fileset is being created.
CREATED: The fileset has been created and is running properly.
RELEASING: The fileset is being released.
RELEASED: The fileset has been deleted
Status.description_zh:
Fileset的状态。包括：

CREATING：正在创建Fileset。
CREATED：Fileset已创建完成，正常运行中。 
RELEASING：Fileset正在释放中。
RELEASED：Fileset已删除

UpdateTime.description_en:
The time when the fileset was last updated.

Return format: `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`
UpdateTime.description_zh:
Fileset的最近一次更新时间。

返回格式：`yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`
